input.prompt: 16:9. A bright, tidy Korean home kitchen in the late morning. Close over-the-shoulder shot of a Korean woman in her fifties in a soft cardigan sitting at the kitchen table, holding an iPhone 15 Pro at chest height with her thumb on the screen; the phone screen faces the camera, large and unobstructed, and shows one perfectly uniform flat bright chroma-key green image filling the display. On the table, softly out of focus: a cup of barley tea, a small plate of fruit, two supplement boxes without readable labels. Her face is out of frame, only her shoulder, hair and hands are visible. Photograph taken with a Sony A7 IV and a 50mm f/1.4 lens, natural window light, true-to-life colour, crisp focus on the phone and hands, natural optical bokeh, a real candid moment. No readable text anywhere, no logos, no watermark.
